raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 14
, Reason for Mistake: Presented DuckDuckGo’s auto-generated “Search Assist” claim that Louis Jean Marie de Bourbon, Duke of Penthièvre, was the paternal grandfather, conflating the title’s prior holder (the subject’s paternal great-grandfather via his grandmother Louise Marie Adélaïde de Bourbon) with the actual paternal grandfather. The correct paternal grandfather is Louis Philippe II, Duke of Orléans (Philippe Égalité).
